items.description: The Cathedral of St. Peter and St. Paul in Douala is a grand and historic church, reflecting the deep-rooted influence of Catholicism in the coastal city.
The Japoma Stadium in Douala is a modern, high-capacity sports complex that serves as a premier venue for international football and track events.
La Nouvelle Liberte is a massive and controversial statue in Douala, constructed from recycled scrap metal to represent the city's resilience.
The Wouri Bridge is a critical transportation link in Douala, connecting the city's main districts across the expansive Wouri River.
The Royal Palace of Foumban is a landmark of African architecture and the cultural heart of the Bamum people in the West Region.
The Roumde Adjia Stadium in Garoua is a key sporting venue in northern Cameroon, hosting major national and regional football matches.
The Kribi Lighthouse is a picturesque maritime landmark on Cameroon's southern coast, guiding ships into the Atlantic port of Kribi.
The Ahmadou Ahidjo Stadium in Yaounde is a historic sporting arena named after Cameroon's first president, serving as a national icon for sports.
The bustling markets of Yaounde are the vibrant heart of the city, where locals trade everything from fresh produce to traditional crafts.
The coffee gardens around Bamenda offer a glimpse into the region's long-standing coffee culture and traditional highland farming practices.
The cattle ranches around Ngaoundere are central to the Fulbe way of life, reflecting the region's status as Cameroon's pastoral heartland.
River fishing on the Benue near Garoua is a vital traditional activity that sustains the local economy and provides a staple food source.
The cocoa gardens of Ebolowa are the foundation of local livelihoods, where the process of harvesting and drying beans is a common sight.
The artisan market in Foumban is famous for its exquisite bronze work and wood carvings, preserving the ancient crafts of the Bamum people.
The museum park in Dschang is a peaceful cultural space where history, nature, and community life intersect in the western highlands.
